---
title: "jira.psom"
description: "Daily snapshot of every PSOM Jira ticket, one row per ticket per snapshot."
---

Daily snapshot of all PSOM Jira Service Management tickets.

One row per Jira issue per snapshot. Each run writes a full snapshot of the
tickets currently in the PSOM project to a new `date=` partition. Previous
partitions are preserved as an audit trail, enabling point-in-time analysis.
SLA clocks and comments are in their own tables,
[`psom_sla`](psom_sla.qmd) and [`psom_comment`](psom_comment.qmd), which join to
this one on `key` and `date`.

**Jira source:** `jtickets.atlassian.net`, project `PSOM`, fetched via
`POST /rest/api/3/search/jql` with full comment history via
`/rest/api/3/issue/{key}/comment`.

`Keywords`: jira, psom, tickets, service requests, support, form topic

## Provenance

Queried from PSOM Jira Cloud via API by the `psom-sync` Lambda function.

* **Updated**: Daily, at ~06:00 ET
* **Steward**: EDCP Data and Research Team
* **Contact**: [Yinlin Zhang](mailto:yinlin.zhang@cds-snc.ca) (Data and Research team)

## Fields

One row per Jira issue per snapshot (`date` partition).

| Field Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| date | varchar | Partition key: the date the Lambda ran (`YYYY-MM-DD`).|
| key | varchar | Jira ticket key, e.g. `PSOM-42`. |
| summary | varchar | One-line ticket title. |
| description | varchar | Full ticket description, extracted from Atlassian Document Format (ADF) to plain text. |
| issue_type | varchar | Jira issue type name, one of `Email Request`, `Partner Support Request form`. |
| status | varchar | Current workflow status, one of `In progress`, `Waiting for customer`, `Escalated to PTT`, `Escalated to Auth PT`, `Done`, `Canceled`, `Ready to archive`. |
| status_changed | varchar | ISO 8601 timestamp when the ticket's status category last changed. |
| priority | varchar | Priority level, one of `High`, `Normal`, `Low`, `Critical`. |
| assignee | varchar | Display name of the current assignee; empty string if unassigned. |
| reporter | varchar | Display name of the person who reported the ticket. |
| creator | varchar | Display name of the person who created the ticket (may differ from reporter). |
| created | varchar | ISO 8601 timestamp when the ticket was created. |
| updated | varchar | ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent field or comment update. |
| due_date | int | Jira due date. Unused. |
| labels | varchar | Semicolon-separated list of labels applied to the ticket. |
| request_type | varchar | JSM service request type name, e.g. `New Access Request`. Unused. |
| request_participants | varchar | Semicolon-separated display names of request participants (CC'd users). |
| organizations | varchar | Semicolon-separated names of JSM organizations the request is associated with. |
| form_topic | varchar | The ticket's "Form topic" (a multi-select field), as a `; `-separated list of the chosen options. Options are grouped under Already Using, Onboarding, and Escalated from Call Center. A ticket can carry more than one topic. |
| solution_provided | varchar | The ticket's "Solution provided" checkbox: `Yes`, `No`, or `Planned for future`. |
| comment_count | bigint | Total number of comments on the ticket. Equals the ticket's row count in [`psom_comment`](psom_comment.qmd) for the same `date`. |
| fetched_at | varchar | UTC timestamp when the Lambda wrote this row (`YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`). |

## Notes

All timestamp columns (`created`, `updated`, `status_changed`, `fetched_at`)
are stored as `varchar`. The ISO 8601 ones carry an offset from UTC, e.g.
`2026-09-25T10:31:43.801-0400`.

**Schema rework on 2026-09-28.** The `sla_first_response_*` and
`sla_time_to_done_*` columns moved to [`psom_sla`](psom_sla.qmd), and the JSON
`comments` column moved to [`psom_comment`](psom_comment.qmd). The older
partitions were rewritten to the new schema, so every partition has the same
columns. `form_topic` and `solution_provided` were added at the same time. They
are null in every partition before 2026-09-29, while new rows use an empty
string when no option is chosen. Treat null and empty string alike.
